brief.text: Medical equipment and healthcare providers represent a substantial portion of the activity, with ENOV, ATEC, ETRA, XGN, and STLN all recording insider filings. UPBD drew the highest concentration of individual buyers, where eight distinct insiders executed transactions totaling $1.84 million. The largest single purchase came from FUN, where Rehan Jaffer committed $14.93 million—accounting for almost the entirety of the company's $15.07 million cluster total—while GLXY was the only other stock to surpass $10 million with $10.19 million across two buyers.
